sources.title: Reka and Moonvalley Join Forces to Advance Models and Infrastructure ...
sources.snippet: San Francisco, CA — June 4 — Reka, an AI research lab building foundational intelligence for the physical world, has joined forces with Moonvalley, adding a team of 50 multimodal AI researchers and engineers to accelerate development of next-generation video AI and physical reasoning capabilities.
